Human Civilization Territory, Southern Star Region.

A piece of starry sky emitting space-time fluctuations appeared before Lin Yuan as he closely observed the area ahead.

“Is this one of the three hundred and thirty-three entrances to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm?” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The reason why human civilization did not monopolize the Xuan Huang Secret Realm was precisely because there were simply too many entrances to this secret realm.

Over three hundred in total.

...

And they were scattered throughout the universe.

For instance, within the Human Civilization Territory alone, there were nineteen Xuan Huang Secret Realm entrances.

“The Main Universe is vast and endless, and this ‘vastness and endlessness’ refers not only to its size but also to its myriad Spatial Layers,”

“Within countless Spatial Layers, it’s possible for small worlds to be born, attached to the Main Universe, and these are the origins of the Cosmic Secret Realms.”

“Generally speaking, if a certain Cosmic Secret Realm is of great value, Supreme Beings will take action, penetrating through layers upon layers of space to ‘pull’ that small world into the main space of the Main Universe,”

“Or to establish a stable passage to this secret realm.”

Lin Yuan silently pondered.

Within the Secret Realm, there might be resources rarely seen in the Main Universe; of course, the more, the better.

Even large Cosmic Secret Realms cannot withstand the ‘pull’ of Supreme Beings. If one Supreme Being isn’t enough, then two or three will join forces.

But the Xuanhuang Secret Realm…

Even the Supreme Beings couldn’t determine the specific Spatial Layer where this secret realm was located, which was somewhat unbelievable.

If the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had not yet emerged, it could be possible because, after all, even Supreme Beings couldn’t possibly traverse every single Spatial Layer in the Main Universe.

But the Xuanhuang Secret Realm had clearly been opened many times, with pathways connecting it to the outside world, yet Supreme Beings still could not pinpoint the exact Spatial Layer, which was downright inconceivable.

It wasn’t just human Supreme Beings who couldn’t do this; the Alien Strong Ones also couldn’t.

This was also one of the reasons human civilization identified the Xuanhuang Secret Realm as originating from another Cosmic Era; this secret realm was simply not a normal Cosmic Secret Realm, and there was some being that deliberately concealed its coordinates.

Moreover, strong beings who entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm for exploration on occasion gained Secret Techniques and treasures completely different from the current styles of the Ten Thousand Universe Races.

“The calling sensation is already extremely strong…” Lin Yuan stood under the starry sky, and as he drew closer to the entrance of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, the calling sensation in his ears grew increasingly strong.

He could even hear some vague voices.

“For this trip into the Secret Realm, I specifically brought three Ninth-tier Secret Treasures for protection…” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The three Ninth-tier Secret Treasures were of the attack type, the physical defense type, and the Soul Defense Type.

Although ninth-rank battles are like contests within countless Spatial Layers, it does not mean that weapon treasures are useless.

You’re protected by defensive treasures, and even if enemies find your Spatial Layer, they can’t kill you.

Of course, these three Ninth-tier Secret Treasures came from contributions by a few of the strongest Eighth Layer talents of the Tianyu Clan.

“This time entering the Secret Realm, the primary goal is to clarify the source of the call. As for the treasures within the Secret Realm? If they come easily, I’ll take them; if not, I’ll let them go.”

Lin Yuan set a basic strategy for his upcoming journey into the Secret Realm.

That was to avoid conflicts with other strong beings as much as possible.

Because Lin Yuan’s goal differed from theirs.

The reason Lin Yuan only arrived now, instead of coming when the Secret Realm opened, was to avoid the ‘peak period’ of Alien Strong Ones entering the Secret Realm.

Once opened, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm could only be sustained for a hundred years.

Therefore, the sooner one entered the Secret Realm, the larger the potential yield.

Lin Yuan arrived a few years later so he wouldn’t likely encounter the first batch of numerous Alien Strong Ones.

“Let’s go in.”

After some thought, Lin Yuan stepped into the nearby starry sky emanating spatial fluctuations.

Hum.

As Lin Yuan walked further into the starry sky, he sensed the twisting changes of space.

“According to the intelligence, any strong being entering the Xuanhuang Secret Realm will randomly appear in the peripheral areas of the realm,” Lin Yuan thought.

This was also why he did not group up with other Evolvers from the human civilization to enter.

Because no matter how much you group, once you enter the Secret Realm, you’ll be separated, making it meaningless.

The spatial fluctuations became more distorted.

When the space stabilized slightly, Lin Yuan had already left the main Spatial Layer of the Main Universe and entered the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“Hm?”

Lin Yuan immediately began observing his surroundings with great caution.

The physical defense treasure, as well as the Soul Defense Treasure, were both operational.

“I haven’t entered any particularly dangerous places…” Lin Yuan looked around at the earthy yellow continent and breathed a sigh of relief.

When you enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, you randomly appear on the outskirts of the realm.

The word “random” is very key here; one might end up in some kind of perilous land.

Although the outermost areas of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm pose basically no threat to ninth-rank lives, there are several forbidden lands that are exceptions.

Even ninth-rank beings would be seriously harmed if they happened to enter those forbidden lands carelessly.

“It seems my luck isn’t bad.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face; the location he was currently in was safe for the time being, and the initial position upon entering the Secret Realm was not bad.

“Spatial Layers…”

Lin Yuan keenly sensed that as a complete world, the Xuanhuang Secret Realm naturally also gave rise to multiple layers of space.

“The number of Spatial Layers this secret realm possesses far exceeds forty thousand…” Lin Yuan thought. His Inner World had opened up forty-five thousand Spatial Layers, so he could roughly sense the number of external world’s space layers.

“I can’t enter instant spatial shifting…”

Lin Yuan tried a bit more and confirmed a piece of intelligence provided by human civilization.

Within the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, there was an invisible spatial suppression; ninth-rank beings could merge with the numerous Spatial Layers, but they couldn’t move instantaneously or teleport through the Space Rules.
